pages.title: The path
pages.text: After the $(l:space/planets/moon)Moon$() key: $(l:space/planets/mars)Mars$(), $(l:space/planets/asteroids)the asteroids$(), $(l:space/planets/venus)Venus$(), $(l:space/planets/mercury)Mercury$(), $(l:space/planets/ceres)Ceres$(), $(l:space/planets/pluto)Pluto$(), $(l:space/planets/haumea)Haumea$(), $(l:space/planets/kuiper_belt)the Kuiper Belt$().

pages.title: Only on the map
pages.text: $(l:space/planets/jupiter)Jupiter$(), $(l:space/planets/saturn)Saturn$(), $(l:space/planets/uranus)Uranus$() and $(l:space/planets/neptune)Neptune$(). Also Deimos, Oberon and Proteus. Barnard is disabled.

pages.title: New entries
pages.text: A planet's entry appears here when you finish researching it at the control station. Moons open together with their planet. The entry also opens if you simply land there.

pages.title: Dungeons
pages.text: A blaze on Ceres, a ghast on Io, an ice blaze on Enceladus.

pages.title: Gear
pages.text: Before landing, sort out oxygen, thermal protection and protection from pressure and radiation. Your base must be sealed. Read about the gauges in $(l:space/survival/hazards)Radiation, Pressure, Heat$().
